title: [QLD] Southern Comfort Original Whiskey 1L $5.90 C&C / in Limited Stores Only @ BWS
body:
Deal: [QLD] Southern Comfort Original Whiskey 1L $5.90 C&C / in Limited Stores Only @ BWS

[BargainsGrabber] Clearly they aren’t and using the negative voting incorrectly
[freewhere] This was NOT reported as QLD-only when the deal was posted.
[BargainsGrabber] @freewhere: And you used the negative voting incorrectly. If you knew it was state specific get the mods to fix it. There’s a report button in each deal for a reason
Member for 9 years should know the rules…
[freewhere] @BargainsGrabber: And how would I have known that it's QLD only? I saw a deal. The deal didn't work. 4 others had reported before me that it doesn't work for them too. I negged it. There's nothing incorrect in that.
[BargainsGrabber] @freewhere: If it doesn’t work for others, it wouldn’t have worked for OP but it did. Like I said, there’s a report button… Report it to the mods so that they can investigate. The fact that you immediately negged the deal shortly after it got posted rather than reporting felt like entitlement, which defeated the whole purpose of a community
Some deals posted on this platform are location specific, I don’t need to waste more time trying to explain to you
[freewhere] @BargainsGrabber: Hindsight is 20/20. You are judging my action based on what you know Now; i posted the comment before the edit. I didn't just assume if the deal had already expired, or was targeted or geo-locked; so i negged it.
[freewhere] This was NOT reported as QLD-only when the deal was posted.

The area group chat was pretty quickly flooded with people asking about protocol, defo a lot of cancelled orders tonight, whether or not that's legal I got no idea.
